purpose: Versioned, self-contained onboarding payload system for context-free controller, operator, reviewer, and universal AI sessions.

file_map.AGENTS.md: Thin coding-agent bootstrap pointing to the handbook and local operator guide.
file_map.CLAUDE.md: Existing Rhino CAD Agent Rules preserved with a minimal onboarding pointer prepended.
file_map..bridge/orientation/manifest.json: Version, protocol compatibility, source paths, payload contract, live-state sources, and precedence order.
file_map..bridge/orientation/reviewer.md: Independent evidence and merge-readiness review guide.
file_map..bridge/orientation/quickstart.md: Minimal context-free role selection and reading sequence.
file_map..bridge/orientation/build_payload.py: Standard-library payload composer using tracked sources and local Git/bridge status commands.
file_map.orient.sh: Executable role-aware payload entrypoint with optional macOS pbcopy support.

generated_live_content: current local main commit from git rev-parse main

payload_contract.copy_behavior: --copy uses pbcopy when available and still prints; --copy-only requires pbcopy and suppresses stdout.

precedence_model: repository-specific safety instructions including AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md

limitations: Live facts describe the local checkout at generation time and may be unavailable outside a Git checkout or if bridge_cli.py cannot execute.
The payload never asserts local Rhino access; it reports only tracked controller state and locally determinable Git/bridge facts.
pbcopy is intentionally not invoked during automated validation to avoid mutating the clipboard.
